ŵीमान/Dear Sir,  
 
In continuation to our letters dated 28.07.2026 & 03.08.2026 and pursuant to 
Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, an Earnings Conference Call was 
conducted on Monday, the 03rd August, 2026 for discussions on Company's business and 
outlook post declaration of Unudited Financial Results for 1st Quarter ended 30th June, 
2026. The Audio recording of the said Earnings Conference Call is available in the 
following link: 
 
Link: 
https://nalcoindia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Audio-recording-
of-the-Earnings-Conference-Call-held-on-03.08.2026.mp3  
 
No Unpublished Price Sensitive Information (UPSI) was shared during the 
aforesaid Earnings Conference Call. 
 
The transcript of the above call will be intimated separately within the time period 
as per the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. 
 
The Earnings Conference Call started at 1030 hours and concluded at 1130 hours. 
 
This is for your information and record. 
 
धɊवाद/Thanking you.
